memory_candidates.content: Fuel-based decision procedures in Lean: a fuel bound proved sufficient via measure domination must be MATERIALIZED as a Nat numeral by any #eval of the procedure (let fuel := f phi is strict), even when early exit means the fuel is never consumed. If the sufficiency bound is doubly-exponential (e.g., derived from a blocking/pigeonhole world bound), 3^bound-class fuels exceed physical memory and every #eval-based conformance row breaks — feasibility of the fuel NUMERAL, not just of the run, must be checked at plan time. Repair space: per-branch fuel budgets (linear-in-universe numerals), well-founded recursion on the measure, or splitting the proof-side procedure from the evaluable one.
